# vendor:sokol/sokol_gfx

Generated by Dado's binding generator from sokol_gfx.h.
A restatement of the header's C declarations.
Review before trusting: a binding generator drafts, it does not certify.

**Hand-edited past the generator, and a regeneration keeps the edits.**
Everything outside the declaration lists — the `define`, `link` and `flags`
clauses, the `when` chains that carry them, the `@const` above them — is
written by hand, and the binding generator cannot derive any of it: which
macro a header wants defined and which library it costs on which platform are
facts about the *system*, not about the header. So the generator does not own
this file, it owns the two regions between `// bindgen:begin …` and `//
bindgen:end …`, and it rewrites exactly those, reading the header, the
package and `merge = true` from the `bindgen.toml` beside this file.

Without `--merge` it writes a whole file and the hand-written half is gone —
without `define "SOKOL_IMPL"` the binding declares functions nothing defines
and the link fails, and without the backend chain the header refuses to
compile at all.
